page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores with 48 vCPUs, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This memory density positions the instance as a memory-optimized resource. It does not include local NVMe SSD storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory capacity offer a robust profile for workloads requiring predictable CPU performance and large memory footprints without the overhead of hyperthreading. This configuration is suitable for memory-intensive applications, enterprise databases, and memory-bound data processing tasks.
